accepted.s: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan is associated with which of the following scientific discoveries?
o: Development of the first artificial satellite
Atomic structure of the 30S ribosomal subunit
Structure of the DNA double helix
accepted.x: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan is known for determining the atomic structure of the 30S ribosomal subunit, which provided insight into protein synthesis.
accepted.tq: Use the scientist–discovery association and distinguish ribosomal research from unrelated landmark discoveries.
accepted.sec: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan - birthplace, Nobel, discovery, Royal Society role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2009 jointly with:
o: Robert W. Holley and Marshall W. Nirenberg
Thomas A. Steitz and Ada Yonath
accepted.x: The 2009 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Venkatraman Ramakrishnan, Thomas A. Steitz and Ada Yonath for studies of the ribosome.
accepted.tq: Test the exact co-laureates rather than confusing them with laureates in medicine or agriculture.
accepted.sec: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan - birthplace, Nobel, discovery, Royal Society role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Venkatraman Ramakrishnan is correct?
o: He served as President of the Royal Society from 2015 to 2020.
He served as President of the Royal Society from 2003 to 2010.
He was knighted in 2003 immediately after becoming an FRS.
He received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2014.
accepted.x: Ramakrishnan was President of the Royal Society during 2015–2020. He became an FRS in 2003, was knighted in 2012 and received the Nobel Prize in 2009.
accepted.tq: Separate closely spaced years and distinguish the Royal Society presidency from other honours.
accepted.sec: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan - birthplace, Nobel, discovery, Royal Society role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Venkatraman Ramakrishnan became a Fellow of the Royal Society in 2003.
2. He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2010.
3. He was knighted in 2012.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: he became an FRS in 2003, received the Padma Vibhushan in 2010 and was knighted in 2012.
accepted.tq: Check each chronological honour independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan - birthplace, Nobel, discovery, Royal Society role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about M.S. Swaminathan:
1. He was associated with the development of high-yielding dwarf varieties of wheat and rice.
2. He chaired the National Commission on Farmers.
3. He founded the M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation in Chennai.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Swaminathan was associated with high-yielding dwarf crops, chaired the National Commission on Farmers and founded MSSRF in Chennai.
accepted.tq: Combine agricultural contribution, commission and institution facts in a coded statement question.

accepted.s: The reports of the National Commission on Farmers are popularly known as the:
accepted.x: The reports of the National Commission on Farmers are popularly known as the Swaminathan report.
accepted.tq: Use the commission–report-name association and reject names linked to other scientific fields.
accepted.sec: M.S. Swaminathan - Green Revolution, titles, commission, foundation, Bharat Ratna  [other exams]

accepted.s: M.S. Swaminathan received the first World Food Prize in:

accepted.sec: M.S. Swaminathan - Green Revolution, titles, commission, foundation, Bharat Ratna  [other exams]

during his lifetime for work in space science

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes A.P.J. Abdul Kalam’s role in India’s space programme?
o: Founder of the Physical Research Laboratory at Ahmedabad
Project director of SLV-3, which placed Rohini in orbit in 1980
Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission during Aryabhata’s launch
Director of SITE for the transmission of programmes to 2,400 villages
accepted.x: Abdul Kalam was the project director of SLV-3, which placed the Rohini satellite in orbit in 1980.
accepted.tq: Match the scientist with the precise project role and reject roles belonging to Sarabhai or other programmes.
accepted.sec: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam - space and missile roles, books, presidency, aircraft, awards  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following missile programmes was led by A.P.J. Abdul Kalam?
accepted.x: Kalam led the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme, associated with missiles such as Agni, Prithvi, Akash, Trishul and Nag.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct programme from a group of nearby scientific and developmental initiatives.
accepted.sec: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam - space and missile roles, books, presidency, aircraft, awards  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about A.P.J. Abdul Kalam:
1. He played a key role in Pokhran-II in 1998.
2. He was the 11th President of India.
3. He served as President during 2002–2007.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kalam played a key role in Pokhran-II, was India’s 11th President and served from 2002 to 2007.

Ignited Minds, The Discovery of India and Wings of Fire

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events associated with India’s space and nuclear programmes in chronological order:
A. Pokhran-II
B. Launch of Rohini by SLV-3
C. Renaming of Wheeler Island as Abdul Kalam Island
D. Abdul Kalam’s term as President of India begins

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Vikram Sarabhai is correct?
o: He became Chairman of ISRO only after the launch of Aryabhata in 1975.
He headed INCOSPAR in 1962 and was the first Chairman of ISRO until his death in 1971.
He founded ISRO in 1947 and chaired it until 1980.
accepted.x: Sarabhai headed INCOSPAR from 1962; it became ISRO in 1969, and he served as ISRO’s first Chairman until his death in 1971.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the predecessor organisation, its conversion into ISRO and the correct tenure dates.
accepted.sec: Vikram Sarabhai - institutions, awards, facilities named after him

accepted.s: Which institution was founded by Vikram Sarabhai in Ahmedabad in 1947?
accepted.x: Vikram Sarabhai founded the Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad in 1947. The Community Science Centre was established in 1965, while TERLS was set up near Thiruvananthapuram.
accepted.tq: Use the founding year and location to distinguish among institutions associated with Sarabhai.
accepted.sec: Vikram Sarabhai - institutions, awards, facilities named after him

accepted.s: The Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station was established near:
accepted.x: Sarabhai set up the Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station near Thiruvananthapuram.
accepted.tq: Test the location of a facility and distinguish it from Ahmedabad institutions and Sriharikota.
accepted.sec: Vikram Sarabhai - institutions, awards, facilities named after him

accepted.s: Vikram Sarabhai founded the Darpana Academy in association with:
accepted.x: Vikram Sarabhai founded Darpana Academy with Mrinalini Sarabhai.

accepted.sec: Vikram Sarabhai - institutions, awards, facilities named after him

accepted.s: The Satellite Instructional Television Experiment associated with Vikram Sarabhai provided television education to approximately:
accepted.x: SITE was conducted during 1975–76 and provided television education to approximately 2,400 villages.
accepted.tq: Combine the programme’s acronym, period and scale to avoid number and date swaps.
accepted.sec: Vikram Sarabhai - institutions, awards, facilities named after him

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with Vikram Sarabhai’s honours?

Bhatnagar Award—1966; Padma Bhushan—1972; Padma Vibhushan—1962

Bhatnagar Award—1962; Padma Bhushan—1972; Padma Vibhushan—1966
